component: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder
primary_visual_authority: Original approved Calder Find Your Fit reference

corrections.source: Approved Calder Find Your Fit reference; fitment.visual-spec.v2; High-Fidelity v5 desktop renders
corrections.reference_requirement: The center-right artwork must reproduce the approved recognizable large cropped Calder multi-spoke wheel technical drawing. The wheel—not a radar/target construction—must be the primary readable artwork, while preserving the established crop, scale, placement, fade/opacity, color, clipping, and relationship to the controls and vehicle divider.
corrections.hf_v5_measurement: Artwork occupies the established center-right region, but its dominant visible structure remains concentric circular/radar geometry with sparse radial segments rather than the approved dense, recognizable multi-spoke Calder wheel.
corrections.delta: Positioning/region is substantially retained, but the defining wheel identity is still absent. The approved reference reads immediately as a multi-spoke wheel; HF v5 reads primarily as technical/radar geometry.
corrections.materiality_evidence: The discrepancy is clearly visible in a normal side-by-side comparison without measurement overlays and materially changes the identity and visual weight of the principal decorative artwork in the center-right desktop panel.
corrections.why_material: Artwork is an explicit high-fidelity property. The reference's recognizable multi-spoke wheel is a dominant visual feature; replacing it with concentric/radial geometry changes the composition's visual character rather than producing a negligible raster variance.
corrections.why_another_implementation_pass_is_requi: HF5-001 is a HIGH-severity active correction and its explicit artwork acceptance condition remains unsatisfied. The v6 gate therefore permits one narrowly scoped additional pass.
corrections.recommended_correction: Replace the current center-right concentric/radar construction with the recognizable multi-spoke Calder wheel technical artwork shown in the approved reference. Match the established wheel-art region and reference-like crop, scale, opacity/fade, color and clipping. Do not alter the accepted shell, tabs, header, form geometry, CTA, selected-vehicle region, panel surfaces, or mobile layout. Do not attempt another incremental modification of the radar motif; the final rendered artwork must visibly read as the approved wheel.
corrections.acceptance_condition: At the 2048 × 682 desktop capture, both By Vehicle and By Wheel Style visibly show a recognizable large cropped multi-spoke Calder wheel technical drawing in the established center-right artwork region. Its spoke/rim structure is immediately identifiable as a wheel in a normal side-by-side comparison with the approved reference; concentric radar/target geometry is no longer the dominant read. Scale, crop, placement, fade/opacity, color, clipping, and relationships to the controls and vehicle divider remain materially conformant. No protected resolved area is materially regressed.

protected_resolved_areas: contour artwork outside the active wheel correction
implementation_constraints: Do not reopen protected resolved areas without material regression evidence.
Do not add optional polish or new target measurements.
